{{Quote|You're not getting away this time!|Darth Jerra|<ref name="Jerra's Persistence">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=item|Jerra's Persistence|[[Sabacc Sav]] on [[Carrick Station]] and [[Morro the Reaper]] on [[Vaiken Spacedock]]}}</ref>}}
'''Darth Jerra''' was an individual<ref name="Jerra's Persistence" /> affiliated with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Sith" /> They claimed to an unspecified individual that they were not getting away this time.<ref name="Jerra's Persistence" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Jerra was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', a [[2019]] expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the game, they are mentioned in the description for the "Jerra's Persistence" Tactical item as the author of a quote provided in it.<ref name="Jerra's Persistence" />
